desc:
Brawlbox is a free 2D platform fighter. Knock your opponents off the stage in fast matches, solo against CPUs or online with up to 8 players.

Play on PC, console, phone and tablet (touch controls included).

- 70 legends, each with their own weapons and moves
- Casual online matches and ranked ladders (1v1 and 2v2)
- Party up with friends or host a custom lobby
- Join tournaments with a code
- Training Ground, replays and cosmetics to unlock

In active development, with updates every week. Jump in and pick your fighter!
